Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.adventureCards.projectiles.Projectile
Direct Known Subclasses:
BigFire, BigMeteor, SmallFire, SmallMeteor
public abstract class Projectile extends Object
Represents a projectile that can be fired at a ship. It has a direction and a dice roll that determine its origin.

      public Projectile(IntSupplier dice, Direction direction)
      Constructs a Projectile with a specified dice roll and direction. (used for testing purposes)
      Parameters:
      dice - the dice roll that determines the projectile's origin
      direction - the direction from which the projectile is fired

  • Method Details

    • fireAt

      public boolean fireAt(ShipBoard shipBoard)
      After any activation took place, this method is called to remove the component at getComponentPositionToRemove, if any. The return value indicates whether a component was actually removed.
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship that is threatened by the projectile
      Returns:
      true if a component is removed (in that case a check on the connectivity should take place), false otherwise

    • getActivatablePoints

      public abstract Set<Point> getActivatablePoints(ShipBoard shipBoard)
      Returns the set of locations of the activatable components to protect from a specific projectile.
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship that is threatened by the projectile
      Returns:
      the set of locations of the activatable components of the right type to protect from a projectile
